question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**meal**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses cooking and sharing food with others.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate something that is prepared for eating.
 
• "**Meal**" fits well as it refers to food that has been cooked and prepared for consumption.
 
• Other options ("**card**", "**biscuits**", "**tea**") do not fit the context of preparing a dish for others.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Card (कार्ड): A card is unrelated to food preparation.
 
• Biscuits (बिस्कुट): While biscuits are food, they are not a complete meal.
 
• Tea (चाय): Tea is a beverage, not a prepared meal.
